# Zye.AI

> Zye.AI is a small, independent AI studio making practical tools for builders and vibe coders.

## Products
- [The Build Brief](https://buildbrief.zye.ai/): free weekday AI brief for builders (AI models, agents, vibe coding, tech and security), every weekday at 7:30 AM ET.
- [Unbroke](https://unbroke.zye.ai/): fixes broken vibe-coded apps. Agents diagnose, a human reviews every fix. Quick Diagnosis $29, Fix It $149, Launch Check $399.
